Try to get your brakes adjusted at least once a year.

technicalInformation.name: How to choose the size of your st 120 mountain bike
technicalInformation.value:
Several sizes available: 
S: between 5ft  and 5.4ft 
M: between 5ft.4in and 5ft.8in
L: between 5ft. 8in and 5ft.11in
XL: between 5ft.11in and 6ft. 3in 
To adapt the bike to your height and size, try these tips:
1/ Sitting on the saddle, you should be able to touch the ground with the tips of your toes.
2/ To adjust the saddle height, your knee should be slightly flexed with the foot on the pedal in the lowest position.
3/ If you're between two sizes, choose the larger size.

technicalInformation.name: A light, comfortable, fun frame
technicalInformation.value:
Our designers have created an entirely new frame that's easy to get onto for both men and women.

The CGF frame (Comfort Geometry Frame) is 100% aluminium for optimal comfort and excellent manoeuvrability. The slope angle has been designed to keep your back straight whilst the low rear ensures the bike is very agile when turning.

technicalInformation.name: Rear suspension: none
technicalInformation.value:
This mountain bike has no rear suspension. It is a "semi-stiff" mountain bike: ideal for beginners. 

Compared with a full suspension bike (with rear suspension) the benefit is clear: it weighs much less so you waste less energy on flat terrain.

A "semi-rigid" bike such as the ST 120 is a good choice for your first rides!

technicalInformation.name: What our team has to say
technicalInformation.value:
We created this ST 120 mountain bike at our B'Twin Village (Lille, France) especially for mountain biking enthusiasts.
Recreational mountain bikers told us they wanted comfort, effectiveness and durability. Those features were our starting point as we designed, developed and tested the ST 120 mountain bike, with real riders involved throughout the project.

technicalInformation.name: A unisex mountain bike
technicalInformation.value:
The ST 120 mountain bike is designed for men and women alike.

The ST 120's CGF frame has been designed in great detail to make it light and comfortable, with a very pronounced top tube slope, and a very broad range of sizes (from S: 1.50 m to XL: 2.00 m).

To make the most of the improved comfort, the women of the Rockrider team recommend the 500 Women's Sports saddle, which is adapted to the female figure.

technicalInformation.name: Front suspension for cushioning lumps and bumps
technicalInformation.value:
The 80 mm front suspension helps you get started with overcoming obstacles on slightly uneven trails easily.
Easily adjust the hardness using U-Fit technology (weight adjuster). Simply set the number to your weight (55 kg to 105 kg) using the dial on the fork.

technicalInformation.name: 27.5" wheels & tyres for dry terrain: READY TO ROLL?
technicalInformation.value:
Overcome your first obstacles without fear: small rocks, cracks, holes and bumps!
The wheels of the ST 120 are tolerant and robust, with 27.5" double-walled 28-spoke rims.
Because your first tours will be on dry ground, the Dry 27.5 x 2.0 tyres are most suitable. Their performance is optimised thanks to the fast central section, whilst the side knobs provide good grip on turns.

technicalInformation.name: Stem, handlebar, grips: for good hand positioning
technicalInformation.value:
With a stem that tilts 10° upwards, the ST 120 gives you a raised, accessible, comfortable riding position.

In detail: 

90mm aluminium stem with an angle of 10° for maximum comfort
- 640mm-wide steel handlebar, for stability and control
-"Soft touch" lamellar grips for a firm yet soft and pleasant grasp.

technicalInformation.name: Comfort & safety
technicalInformation.value:
We recommend that beginners wear cycling shorts with a pad (foam in the shape of a saddle) or a gel saddle cover to reduce soreness.

For longer rides, remember to take something to drink (e.g: a hydration bladder or bottle). 

In all circumstances, even for a short ride, wearing a helmet is essential!

technicalInformation.name: Easily transport and store your mountain bike
technicalInformation.value:
Not all rides start on your doorstep. Need to take off the front wheel or transport it? To make it easier to mount / remove your front wheel, we've fitted it with a quick-release system.

A bike carrier will make your life easier if you want to avoid dirtying your car.

technicalInformation.name: Saddle: sit comfortably!
technicalInformation.value:
The ST 120's saddle fixing (welded) prevents any saddle movement as you cycle.

Because your comfort is our next priority after safety, we've added an exclusive wider Ergofit saddle with a hammock shape.

Easily adjust the height of your saddle with the Flex steel seat post, either 350mm or 400mm long (according to the bike size). Its reduced diameter of 27.2mm provides your seat with natural flexibility, 30% more than a standard solution.

technicalInformation.name: Accessories
technicalInformation.value:
Your ST 120 mountain bike is supplied with a bell, lights, wheel reflectors and pedals.

The frame is compatible with:
-Front and rear mudguards (Flash MTB or MTB 700)
-Stand (500 Adult Base)
-Bottle cage

technicalInformation.name: Fitness T-shirts vs. running T-shirts: what's the difference?
technicalInformation.value: When doing fitness activities, you move in all directions. Fabrics need to be stretchy and breathable to follow your every move and provide good moisture management. All our products were designed to meet these needs which are different to running!

technicalInformation.name: Are products tested before being sold?
technicalInformation.value:
Of course! All our fabrics must successfully pass rigorous lab tests to ensure your comfort and safety. We test them for colourfastness, resistance to repeated washing, perspiration wicking and more. We call these our "torture tests".
And after that? Is that it? 
No, there's more. We then have sports users put our products through the ringer. We listen to and analyse their feedback to fix what needs to be improved. And only then is your sports clothing ready!

technicalInformation.name: The 360° concept: clothes that move with you!
technicalInformation.value: An example? All our T-shirts feature a special cut at the shoulders to keep you moving freely. How did we come up with the idea? Our team observed users at gyms and worked with our R&D lab. And because style also matters, our designers drew inspiration from the energy of the sport to create dynamic lines. technicalInformation.name: Compression - improve performance:
technicalInformation.value:
We conducted a study into the effects of compression when running. 
The study proved that when runners wear KIPRUN compression socks:
1 - blood flow is improved by 47% which increases oxygen levels in the muscles,
2 - vibration in tissues is reduced, which in turn reduces muscle damage,
3 - biochemical parameters for running are improved.
As a result, wearing compression socks helps improve running performance.

technicalInformation.name: During exertion
technicalInformation.value:
The compression from the sock is effective DURING exertion. 
This sock is not suitable for recovery.

technicalInformation.name: Benefits of the specific yarn
technicalInformation.value: Energise, tone up and improve performance with the specific yarn in the 900 compression socks. The natural mineral permanently incorporated into the fibre reflects the thermal energy of the body to gently energise your cells, improve muscle elasticity and enhance the appearance of your skin. The results of the tests of the specific yarn show that these incredible fabrics offer both athletic performance and benefits for physical appearance.

technicalInformation.name: How to slip on the leg sleeve
technicalInformation.value:
Roll your sock back over itself from the calf down to the ankle.
Using both hands, stretch your sock out to the side to get it over your foot and ankle, then roll it carefully up the leg from just above the ankle joints.
Adjust the sock so it is just below the knee, ensure the material is evenly spread around the calf with no folds along the leg*.

technicalInformation.name: Effectiveness of the compression/sizes
technicalInformation.value:
The 900 compression socks are more effective than the 500 compression socks because they cover more calf circumference sizes. And above all, each size offers a narrower calf circumference range for greater effectiveness, especially at the outer limits of every range.
The more precise calf design and finer knit also ensure more effective performance.

technicalInformation.name: How to choose your size:
technicalInformation.value:
For superior performance, take various precise measurements of your biggest calf and select the matching sock size.
size S - calf circumference: 28 / 31 CM
size M - calf circumference: 32 / 35 CM 
size L - calf circumference: 36 / 39 CM
size XL - calf circumference: 40 / 43 CM

technicalInformation.name: A user-friendly design.
technicalInformation.value:
The 500 ml water bottle has a thumb hole so that you can carry it effortlessly.The bite valve of the water bottle has an on/off position. In the off position, you can avoid any nasty surprises during transportation. In the on position, the water bottle will not leak while you are running: pinch the bite valve and suck to drink.
Finally, the water bottle is designed so that you can drink without removing it from the front pocket of your bag.

technicalInformation.name: How far can you run with this water bottle and what is it compatible with?
technicalInformation.value:
With its 500 ml capacity, the flexible water bottle is useful for about one hour of running time, on average.
And to make your preparation and kit simpler, the 500 ml water bottle is compatible with all our hydration vests and hydration belts designed to hold 500 ml bottles

technicalInformation.name: A flexible water bottle for making your runs more comfortable.
technicalInformation.value:
Our design team is committed to providing flexible containers for training sessions and races.
Compared with a rigid water bottle, this bottle is lighter, less noisy when you run and does not hinder your movements as much.
What's more, it occupies less space: You can compress it gradually as you drink the contents, thereby reducing its volume!

technicalInformation.name: How to maintain the water bottle?
technicalInformation.value:
To prevent any taste of plastic, rinse the water bottle in clean water three times before using it. Then, dry it upside down without the bite valve. If the plastic taste persists, place the dry water bottle in the freezer.

You can remove the bite valve to clean it. This is particularly important if you are using sugary drinks!
Finally, so that it doesn't make noise while you are running, remember to remove any air by sucking out the air bubbles.

technicalInformation.name: How was the 500 mL water bottle tested?
technicalInformation.value: To guarantee the quality of the 500 ml water bottle, our design team asked 12 runners to use it during a running session on a treadmill. Running on a treadmill allows you to focus on the flow rate of the bite valve, the fact that the water is tasteless, the comfort of the bite valve, the movement of the water bottle and how easy it is to use.Thanks to the feedback from our testers, we designed a product suited to road and trail running.

technicalInformation.name: How to protect yourself from the sun:
technicalInformation.value:
Although this cap offers protection from the sun, the following precautions should be taken before heading out on the roads or trails:
-   Check the weather forecast so you can bring appropriate equipment.
-   Protect the parts of your body that are exposed to the sun throughout the race.
-   Wear sunglasses.
-   Regularly apply sunscreen.
-   Eat and drink at regular intervals.

technicalInformation.name: PERSPIRATION WICKING and VENTILATION
technicalInformation.value:
To guarantee optimal comfort during activity, perspiration wicking and staying cool are essential. 
In addition to a quick-dry main component that transfers moisture  away from your head, we have optimised the mechanical ventilation in a number of ways:
We have added laser micro-perforations to the side sections.
An opening has also been added at the back to improve air circulation.

technicalInformation.name: Care instructions
technicalInformation.value:
If your visor loses its shape after being squashed in a bag, don't panic,
just wash and flat dry and it will return to its original shape!
Our running accessories, with thermobonded finishing touches, are not fond of washing machines and high temperatures.
We recommend that you preserve the technical qualities of the product by hand-washing it and drying it in the fresh air.

technicalInformation.name: Which head size should i choose for this one-size, no-adjustment cap?
technicalInformation.value:
To make the most of your activity, it is essential to have a suitable product for your body shape (neither too small, nor too large).
This one-size-fits-all running cap has a stretchy component at the neck which can fit head sizes of between 54 and 59 cm.
Remember to measure your head size!

technicalInformation.name: And what about the DESIGN?
technicalInformation.value:
A modern, stylish design, geared to performance.
This cap preserves the characteristics of its big sister - the 5-panel cap in our range - while being the lightest and most elegant of all.
To accentuate its technical features, our designer has included a pattern on the top and selected thermobonded finishing touches on some sections.
An essential running accessory - perfect to complete your outfit!

technicalInformation.name: What is an ADJUSTABLE visor?
technicalInformation.value:
The visor of our ultra-light running cap has been designed to be worn in two different ways:
In 'classic' or 'down' position, it protects from direct sun rays.
When it gets darker, choose the 'raised' or 'up' position for better visibility!
You can also wear the visor up just for a different look.
The height of the visor is 6 cm.

A plus for trail runners:
wearing the visor in 'up' position is nifty on slopes!

technicalInformation.name: Why protect your head?
technicalInformation.value: The hypothalamus located at the back of the head has several functions, including body temperature regulation. It is important to protect your head from the sun's rays, to prevent overheating and the risk of sunstroke that may cut your run short!
